title: Shallower model with preserved embedding dimension
reflection: Hypothesis was that reducing FLOPs/token (fewer transformer blocks) would enable more optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget, potentially compensating for reduced capacity. Result: val_bpb=1.011091 (baseline 0.996598), a 1.4% regression. Training completed normally without crashes. Conclusion: model capacity is the bottleneck, not compute budget. Even with more training steps, 6 layers is insufficient compared to baseline 8 layers. Confirms that the baseline depth=8 is well-optimized. Depth reduction does not improve convergence—the capacity loss outweighs any step-count gain.
